rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unfavourable effect or a generally negative outlook.

example.english: This news has a very negative impact on the stock market.
example.traditional: 呢個消息對股市嘅影響好負面。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 deoi3 gu2 si5 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 fu6 min6

rows.note: Use this for a number or measurement that is below zero.

example.english: Tonight's temperature will be negative, below zero.
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 hei3 wan1 wui5 dai1 gwo3 ling4 dou6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a medical or other test result that is negative.

example.jyutping: go3 cak1 si3 git3 gwo2 hai6 jam1 sing3

rows.note: Use this instead of 負面 when you specifically mean pessimistic or not expecting good results.

example.english: I have a negative outlook on this plan's prospects.
example.traditional: 我對今次計劃嘅前景唔樂觀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gam1 ci3 gai3 waak6 ge3 cin4 ging2 m4 lok6 gun1
